scripts.text:
[Blacksmith]
You've never heard of me? Why, I'm the Veteran Blacksmith of this land. I've spent 30 years in this hot and bloody hellfire, bending steel to my iron will!
scripts.translation:
[铁匠]
你竟然没听说过我？哼，我可是这片土地上的资深铁匠。在这片炽热血腥的炼狱里，我挥锤三十年，把钢铁锻造成形，任它听从我的意志！

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith]
But...
I am growing older and my prowess begins to fade with age. So I've invented something for young, hot, upcoming Blacksmiths, in hopes that they too will master my craft...
scripts.translation:
[铁匠]
但是...我日渐衰老，技艺也开始随岁月流逝。
于是，我为那些年轻、热血、前途无量的铁匠们发明了一样东西，希望他们也能掌握我的技艺...

scripts.text: What is it?
scripts.translation: 是什么？

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith]
We Blacksmiths must always manipulate steel under extreme heat, and the hot air and melted metals are more than most people can stand.
scripts.translation:
[铁匠]
我们铁匠必须在极度的高温下操控钢铁，而灼热的空气和熔化的金属，是大多数人无法忍受的。

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith]
For the sake of our craft, our beautiful, yet masculine faces are put at risk...
scripts.translation:
[铁匠]
为了这门手艺，我们英俊又阳刚的脸庞总是暴露在危险之中...

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith]
But with this wonder of technology, there's no need to worry! Behold, the ^3355FFWelding Mask^000000 !!
scripts.translation:
[铁匠]
有了这项科技奇迹，就不用担心了！看这边，^3355FF焊工面罩^000000！！

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith]
It works by covering your face with a fat metal plate. Truly, it's an item that everyone should want! If not yourself, it'd be a good idea to give this to a friend who is studying smithing.
scripts.translation:
[铁匠]
它用厚厚的金属板遮住你的脸。真是人人都想要的好东西！如果你用不上，也可以送给正在学习锻造的朋友。

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith]
So how about it ? If you give me ^2244FF50 Steel^000000 and ^4422FFonly 2000 Zeny^000000, I will make it for you right away~!!
scripts.translation:
[铁匠]
怎么样？只要给我^2244FF50块钢铁^000000和^4422FF区区2000 Zeny^000000，我马上就为你打造~！！

scripts.text: Hm... Not bad. Alright.
scripts.translation: 嗯...还不错。好吧

scripts.text: How does it work again?
scripts.translation: 它是怎么用的来着？

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith]
Ah, I see that you appreciate a Blacksmith's work! Alright, I'll do it right away !!
scripts.translation:
[铁匠]
啊，看来你很欣赏铁匠的手艺！好，我马上就动手！！

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith]
Hahaha~! Make good use of that!
scripts.translation:
[铁匠]
哈哈哈~！好好利用它吧！

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith]
Hmmm...
You do not have the items I require.
scripts.translation:
[铁匠]
嗯...
你没有我需要的材料。

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith]
A common Blacksmith would interpret this as a sign of disrepect, but I will forgive you. Just don't forget what I need if you want me to make you this mask.
scripts.translation:
[铁匠]
一般的铁匠会觉得这是对他的不敬，不过我原谅你。想让我打造面罩的话，可别忘了所需材料。

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith]
The ^3355FFWelding Mask^000000 protects your face by covering it with a fat metal plate. This invention is the result of 30 years of endless toil at the hammer and anvil.
scripts.translation:
[铁匠]
^3355FF焊工面罩^000000用厚厚的金属板遮住脸，以此保护面部。这项发明凝聚了我三十年来在铁砧前不懈劳作的心血。

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith]
Ah...!
I guess this is the first time you've met a Blacksmith as great as me, and you're just speechless with awe. Please, take your time and speak up when you are ready.
scripts.translation:
[铁匠]
啊...！
我想你一定是第一次见到像我这样伟大的铁匠，敬畏得说不出话来了。慢慢来，准备好再开口。

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis guy seems
a little full
of himself.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF这家伙似乎有点自命不凡。^000000

scripts.text:
[Eric]
Please listen
to my story
of my blessed
grandfather.
scripts.translation:
[埃里克]
请听我讲讲我受人敬仰的祖父。

scripts.text: Talk
scripts.translation: 谈谈

scripts.text: Ask about Items needed
scripts.translation: 询问所需材料

scripts.text: Manufacture
scripts.translation: 制造

scripts.text: Quit
scripts.translation: 退出

scripts.text:
[Eric]
My Grandfather, who passed away a few years ago, was special to me. He always stayed with me, and took care of me. He was much better than my old man, who was always busy working.
scripts.translation:
[埃里克]
我的祖父几年前去世了，他对我来说非常重要。他总是陪伴和照顾我，比总是忙着工作的父亲好多了。

scripts.text:
[Eric]
To me, Grandfather's library was always like a fantasy land where I could escape. I spent most of my time there.
scripts.translation:
[埃里克]
对我来说，祖父的图书馆就像是一个可以让我逃离现实的梦幻之地。我大部分时间都花在那里。

scripts.text:
[Eric]
I learned a lot of things from his books in the Library. Grandfather was interested in Alchemy and Music, and his Library was filled with many mysterious old books.
scripts.translation:
[埃里克]
我从祖父图书馆里的书中学到了很多。他对炼金术和音乐很感兴趣，图书馆里收藏着许多神秘的古书。

scripts.text:
[Eric]
One day...
As usual, I went to the Library and discovered an interesting schematic.
scripts.translation:
[埃里克]
有一天...
我像往常一样去了图书馆，发现了一张有趣的设计图。

scripts.text:
[Eric]
It showed some instrument which looked like Ear Muffs that, when worn on the head, could transmit music or whispers to the ears through a thin wire.
scripts.translation:
[埃里克]
那上面画着一种像耳罩的装置，戴在头上后，可以通过细线把音乐或低语声传入耳中。

scripts.text:
[Eric]
I guess...
It is my grand father's unfinished work. I met a few Alchemists and asked them to produce it, but they rejected my offer...
scripts.translation:
[埃里克]
我想...这是祖父未完成的作品。我找了几位炼金术士，请他们帮忙制作，但都被拒绝了...

scripts.text:
[Eric]
In the end, I thought 'I've gotta make it myself.' So I researched for a few years, and now I fully understand how to make that thing. But, I could never gather the materials to make it!
scripts.translation:
[埃里克]
最后我想：“我得自己做。”于是研究了几年，如今我已经完全弄懂了制作方法。可是，我始终凑不齐材料！

scripts.text:
[Eric]
If I can get those articles, I would build it right away. If you are interested in my idea, would you bring them for me?
scripts.translation:
[埃里克]
只要拿到那些材料，我马上就能把它做出来。如果你对这个想法感兴趣，能帮我收集吗？

scripts.text:
[Eric]
All I wanna do is build this thing in honor of my grandfather and finish the work he started. If you ask me to keep it, I wouldn't mind.
scripts.translation:
[埃里克]
我只想完成祖父未竟的事业，以此纪念他。就算你让我把成品留下来，我也不会介意。

scripts.text:
[Eric]
40 ^3355FFSteel^000000
1 ^3355FFOridecon^000000
1 ^3355FFAlcohol^000000
1 ^3355FFCoal^000000
These are the things I need for Grandfather's masterpiece.
*Tap! Tap! Tap!*

[Eric]
Thank you.
Because of you, I could accomplish my grandfather's wish. He would be happy if he looked down on me from Heaven.
scripts.translation:
[埃里克]
谢谢你。
多亏了你，我才能完成祖父的心愿。要是他能在天上看到我，一定会很高兴。

scripts.text:
[Eric]
As I said, please take this. I am just proud that I can make this by myself.
scripts.translation:
[埃里克]
如我所说，请收下这个。能亲手把它做出来，我就已经很自豪了。

scripts.text:
[Eric]
Thank you for trying to help me, but you didn't bring all the items I need. I think you will find them all soon though.
scripts.translation:
[埃里克]
谢谢你愿意帮我，不过你没有带齐所需的材料。我想你很快就能找齐的。

scripts.text:
[Eric]
N-no?
Well...
You have your own
worries, I suppose.
Farewell.
scripts.translation:
[埃里克]
不...吗？
好吧...
我想你也有自己的烦恼。
再见。

scripts.text: Record Holder

scripts.text:
[Nia]
Ah, well, the objective of
the Number Match game is to
guess the number I'm thinking
of. Of course, there are a few
rules that limit the numbers
that I can choose from.
scripts.translation:
[尼娅]
数字猜谜的目标是猜出我心里想的数字。当然，我能选的数字有几条限制。

scripts.text:
[Nia]
All the numbers that I make
up must be 3 digits, I can't
use 0 for any of the digits,
and I can't use the same
number for any of the digits
more than once.
scripts.translation:
[尼娅]
我想的数字必须是三位数，不能包含0，而且每一位都不能重复。

scripts.text:
[Nia]
So, for example, I can't
use the numbers 103, 112,
252, or 701. Those numbers
either have a 0, or they use
the same number in the digits
more than once. Got it now?
scripts.translation:
[尼娅]
比如，我不能用103、112、252或701。
这些数字要么包含0，要么有重复的数字。
明白了吗？

scripts.text:
[Nia]
Now, you only get 5 guesses,
and after each guess, I'll tell
you how many digits you guessed
correctly, followed by the number of correctly guessed digits in
the correct digit place.
scripts.translation:
[尼娅]
你只有5次机会。每次猜完，我会告诉你猜对了几个数字，以及其中几个数字的位置也对。

scripts.text:
[Nia]
For example, let's say the
number I come up with is 168.
If your first guess is 678, then you guessed two of the digits,
6 and 8, correctly. However,
only 8 is in the correct place.
scripts.translation:
[尼娅]
举个例子，假设我想的数字是168。
如果你第一次猜678，那么你猜对了两个数字，6和8。
但是，只有8的位置是正确的。

scripts.text:
[Nia]
You know, it'd be a good idea
if you try the Practice Mode
first. Then, when you're more
comfortable, play the actual
Number Match game. Don't forget that speed counts for your score!
scripts.translation:
[尼娅]
建议你先试试练习模式。
等你熟练了，再玩正式的数字猜谜游戏。
别忘了，速度也会影响你的得分哦！

scripts.text:
[Nia]
Ah, if you happen to
make a new record in the
Number Match game, you'll
have your name recorded,
so don't miss this chance for
fame and maybe even fortune~
scripts.translation:
[尼娅]
如果你在数字猜谜中创下新纪录，你的名字就会被记录下来。别错过成名甚至发财的机会哦~

scripts.text:

Great, let's do a practice
Number Match game. Please
try to guess my number, okay?
If you want to cancel, then please enter a number greater than 1,000.
scripts.translation:

如果想取消，请输入一个大于1000的数字。
